context: M19 o1. Corwin lobby, 98 degrees. Residents in chairs with wet towels. The elevator is dead.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Mr. Arce. The power's off from six to fourteen. Since this morning. Rewiring, they say.

lines.speaker: char.manny_soto
lines.text: Prentiss's order, Teddy. Gus threw the switch. I just hand out the notices.

lines.speaker: char.inez_rivera
lines.text: My kids are at camp, thank God. The old men upstairs aren't at camp.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Mr. Hollis hasn't come down. He always comes down for the shipping news.
